notes.title: Colorize now Available!
notes.notes:
Colorize is now available!

Colorize is an indie precision platformer that combines fast-paced action with mobility and combat abilities. Dive into procedurally remixed levels where precision, timing, and creative builds are your best allies. Each run presents a unique challenge—whether you're leaping across platforms, dodging enemy fire, or unleashing powerful abilities.

What starts as a black & white world fills with color as you unlock different powers. The more abilities you have - the more the levels colorize. 

Each color is tied to a spectrum of abilities. Harness the power of Red to unleash fiery blasts, summon the speed of Yellow for rapid dashes, and wield the webs of Blue to climb high. Want to find out what teal does? You have to play to find out!

Between runs, collect resources and unlock permanent upgrades that enhance your abilities and stats. These upgrades ensure that no run is ever wasted, allowing you to become stronger and delve deeper into the game’s increasingly difficult levels.

I'm very proud of this latest release. I hope you enjoy, and want to come back and try different runs again and again. Feedback is always welcome :)
